intent: Report the music-sales format shares for the United States in 2015 and Japan, preserving labeled categories without numeric values.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the labeled music-sales format shares for the United States in 2015, preserving labeled categories without numeric values.
Report the music-sales format shares for Japan, preserving labeled categories without numeric values.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in United States (2015).
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in Japan.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: In the United States (2015) panel, Digital occupies 66% of music-sales format share, and Physical is a labeled category in the same whole.
accept: Digital shown as 66% of the United States (2015) music-sales format whole
Physical shown as a labeled category in the United States (2015) panel without a numeric value
reject: Digital share omitted or misstated for the United States (2015) panel
Physical numeric value invented or displayed for the United States (2015) panel

accept: Physical shown as 75% of the Japan music-sales format whole
Digital shown as 18% of the Japan music-sales format whole
Remaining Japan share left unspecified or shown as complement without inventing a labeled category
reject: Physical or Digital share omitted or misstated for the Japan panel
Japan shares added to United States shares
Unspecified remainder assigned to a named category not present in the data

optional_valid: Showing the Japan remainder as an unlabeled complement arc
Visually distinguishing the United States and Japan panels as separate wholes
unsupported_to_avoid: Inventing a numeric value for the United States Physical category

review_notes: The United States Physical row is label-only and supports category presence, not a numeric share.
Japan shares sum to 93%, so the complement is unspecified and should not be labeled with an invented category.

approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
